# unraid_disks (Data Source)

All physical disks detected by the server. Requires `READ_ANY` on `DISK`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_disks" "all" {}

output "disk_serials" {
  value = { for d in data.unraid_disks.all.disks : d.device => d.serial_num }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `disks` (Attributes List) List of physical disks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))

<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Device path, e.g. `/dev/sdb`.
- `firmware_revision` (String) Firmware revision.
- `id` (String) Disk identifier.
- `interface_type` (String) `SATA`, `SAS`, `USB`, `PCIE` or `UNKNOWN`.
- `is_spinning` (Boolean) Whether the disk is spinning.
- `name` (String) Model name.
- `serial_num` (String) Serial number.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `smart_status` (String) `OK` or `UNKNOWN`.
- `temperature` (Number) Temperature in °C (null if unavailable).
- `type` (String) Disk type, e.g. `SSD` or `HDD`.
- `vendor` (String) Manufacturer.
